title: BMS Engineer
summary: Builds the battery management system (BMS) of electric vehicles and storage packs: the software that watches each cell, estimates charge and health, balances cells and keeps the pack safe. Sits in the EV battery or powertrain team with cell, hardware and vehicle software engineers.
dailyDuties: Develop and tune state of charge and state of health estimation
Build BMS algorithms in MATLAB, Simulink and Stateflow
Implement cell balancing and protection logic
Fit cell models from lab test data
Write or integrate BMS firmware in embedded C
Define and debug CAN messages with the vehicle
Validate releases on HIL benches and in vehicle trials

skills.expectation: Develop and tune SOC and SOH estimation, from coulomb counting to Kalman filters
Implement cell monitoring, balancing and protection logic with AFE chips
Build cell models from test data and know how Li-ion chemistries behave
Understand how the battery pack and BMS fit into the EV powertrain
Build BMS algorithms in MATLAB, Simulink and Stateflow
Write or integrate BMS firmware in embedded C
Define and debug CAN communication between the BMS and vehicle
Apply ISO 26262 requirements to BMS functions
Validate BMS software on HIL benches
Use Kalman filters for state estimation
Integrate BMS software into an AUTOSAR stack
Use CANoe and UDS diagnostics during testing
Analyse cell and pack test logs

certifications.why: Shows formal ISO 26262 training, which BMS postings ask about
